uncited: The transform decomposes the volume into subbands.
**Transform Construction:** Apply the RDLS-SS-DWT transform to the volume.
**Time Complexity:** The transform involves a 3-level 3D-DWT and a linear pass over the final subbands for prediction and entropy calculation.
**Memory Complexity:** Requires storage for the volume and the subbands.
**Performance:** In experiments on medical images (CT, MRI, US), RDLS-SS-DWT+Pred provided bitrate improvements over standard DWT.
